title: STRONG HOLD IN
THE DAY OF TROUBLE
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering

scenes.a: If trouble has entered your quiet room today, know that you are not left defenseless.
The word of God promises in Nahum chapter one verse seven: The LORD is good, a strong hold in the day of trouble; and he knoweth them that trust in him.
Lord God, when anxiety rises and difficulty presses against us, be our high tower and unfailing fortress.
You see every hidden struggle and You know every soul that rests in You.
Keep us safe beneath Your shadow, shield our families from harm, and fill this space with Your lasting peace.
Subscribe to The Covenant Shield for daily scripture prayers.
